title: Zero Waste Mediterranean Chickpea Flour Dumplings
description: A fermented, velvety, and quick-fix Mediterranean dish featuring chickpea flour, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and made with zero waste in mind.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chickpea flour, water, olive oil, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, and dried thyme, and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Let the batter ferment at room temperature for 2 hours.
After fermentation, stir in lemon juice.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into a large pot of boiling water.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or thyme, if desired.
Serve with a side of your favorite Mediterranean sauce or salad.
